title: Show full charges on the order ticket before the user confirms
problem: Brokerage and statutory charges feel hidden, and fee complaints are a leading cause of 1★ reviews.
evidence: Fees & brokerage is 27.6% of Upstox's 1★ reviews, 17.5% of Groww's and 13.9% of Angel One's.
Those reviews average 1.6★ (Upstox), 1.7★ (Angel One) and 2.4★ (Groww), well below each app's own average.
Users complain about charges 'hidden in the balance' and total costs that exceed the advertised brokerage.

quotes.text: show brokerage charges on order -> list of trades, instead of hiding it in the balance.

title: Make charts fast and stable on mid-range phones
problem: On the market-leading broker, laggy charts dominate dissatisfaction.
evidence: App performance & UX is 41.1% of Zerodha Kite's 1★ reviews (24.0% of all its reviews), averaging 2.72★.
'Advanced charts' come up in 10.7% of Zerodha reviews and 70% of those mentions are negative; at Upstox it is 4.3% of reviews, 76% negative.
Users describe charts that hang or lag when opening option premium charts.

quotes.text: too much laggy, can't even open option premium charts.

metric: Chart load time; perf share of 1★

title: Explain rejected or delayed orders in plain language, in the moment
problem: Failed orders and stuck fund transfers cost users money and trust, with the harshest ratings.
evidence: Order & trade failures average 1.55★ (Zerodha, Angel One) to 2.18★ (Groww) — 1.5 to 2.0 stars below each app's average.
They are 17.2% of Groww's 1★ reviews, 14.6% of Zerodha's and 12.4% of Angel One's.
Support follow-ups are slow: reviewers report requests left 'Processing' for days.

quotes.text: I requested a primary bank account change more than a week ago, but it is still showing 'Processing' and there is no response from support.

metric: Order-failure share of 1★; ticket reopen rate
